fee_notes: Start-Up Franchise fee is $59,900 for a territory of 60,000 single family households, adjusted $1 per household above/below 60,000. Conversion Franchise fee is $25,000 plus any third-party referral commissions, capped at $59,900. Refranchise fee is included in the purchase price paid to the affiliate. Fees may be negotiated, waived, or partially financed (up to 75%). A 10% military discount applies for honorably discharged veterans purchasing their first franchise. All fees are non-refundable.
raw_excerpt: The initial franchise fee for a Start-Up Franchise is $59,900 for a territory containing 60,000 single family households. If we agree on a territory containing a different number of single family households, we will increase or decrease the franchise fee by $1 for each single family household above or below 60,000. The initial franchise fee for a Conversion Franchise is $25,000 plus the amount of any commission we have to pay to a third-party referral service or franchise services organization in connection with your franchise purchase. However, the total of these two items will be capped at $59,900. The initial franchise fee for a Refranchise is included in the purchase price you pay our affiliate for the Company-Owned Center.
